name: sauberes-wo-rev-ne
description: Local WRN platform foundation with separately buildable mobile and website clients.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:mobile && pnpm run build:website
scripts.check: pnpm run toolchain:check && pnpm run check:release-boundaries && pnpm run format && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run check:fixture-provenance && pnpm run check:brand-assets && pnpm run test
